primary_endpoint: The lab against the same-cost vote on every held-out task, the 80 BioDSA tasks (prereg/heldout-biodsa.json) and the 16 planted tasks (prereg/heldout-planted.json) pooled: an exact one-sided sign test on the discordant tasks at alpha 0.05, computed by lab/heldout.py (python3 -m lab.heldout runs/heldout). A task with no graded answer counts as failed for that arm. Reported with it, whatever the result: the lab's share of discordant wins with its exact 95% interval, the discordant task ids, every arm's passes and dollars. Secondary, description only: the lab against every other arm, pooled and per benchmark; the planted tasks by faulted or clean twin and by fault family; the convention note's effect (Opus alone with it against Opus alone without it, prereg/heldout-biodsa-plain.json).
stop_rules: Each arm runs once. A halt by a usage limit (including Fable's weekly limit), a spending cap or a crash is resumed with the same command; nothing is re-planned and no arm is re-run because of its result. A run that stops without an error of its own is not restarted without the owner's go-ahead. Grading runs once, after every agent of every arm in all three specs has exited: grade, then measures, then python3 -m lab.heldout. If an arm is broken (not merely unlucky), the batch is stopped and reported, not fixed in place.
notes: Every arm reads task.md plus CONVENTION_NOTE (lab/adapters/biodsa.py). research/heldout-plan.md, decisions of 2026-11-18. Opus in every lab role, exactly the loop-2 incumbent (M-17); re-check and guard off. Vote k from dev (M-18, ledger entry 70): lab dollars a task over Opus dollars an attempt, rounded half up: 15 on BioDSA ($1.564 / $0.1076), 13 on the planted suite ($1.462 / $0.1091). A vote attempt cost $0.13 on BioDSA in the smoke test against $0.11 for a plain attempt, so the vote may cost somewhat more than the lab; that favours the control. The lab keeps its literature search with every staged task's source identifiers blocked (BioDSA.blocked_terms covers both splits); the single-model arms have no search. The lab's memory (--memory past) carries what it wrote on dev tasks, including the planted dev pilot; that is part of the lab's design and the single-model arms have none. Resuming the self-challenge arm restarts a stopped task from its first step (M-18). Expected spend about $460 in all three specs; caps below.
